overrides.rule: A task gets three rounds of fix and re-review, not five.
overrides.why: The loop stops early and asks the director, instead of grinding through five rounds.

overrides.rule: A fix made after the final review is reviewed again, never taken on trust.
overrides.why: A single fix pass with no second look lets a bad fix reach the merge.

overrides.rule: Anything at decision level 3 or 4 (what users see, settings, the guardrails) is a question for the director, and you pause on it.
overrides.why: The skills tell an agent to rule on every conflict itself; matters the director owns must reach them.

anchors.text: link it for your human partner

overrides.rule: Do not ask for a plan review, an execution method or a finishing choice; go straight from the plan to building.
overrides.why: Nobody reads the session chat, so a question asked there waits for ever.

anchors.text: | A quick, clear task | the request itself | do it |
invoke superpowers:writing-plans and no other skill

overrides.rule: A quick change goes to the quick lane, and an approved design or brief goes to the foreman's queue.
overrides.why: The front desk talks to the director; building and planning belong to the lanes and the foreman.

anchors.text: Use the least powerful model that can handle each role to conserve cost and increase speed.

overrides.rule: Every subagent's model is the one the project's routing table names for its role.
overrides.why: Models are chosen once, in the routing table, by role; an agent picking its own breaks that.

overrides.rule: A per-task or whole-branch review uses Wheelhouse's reviewer agent, which can read but cannot write.
overrides.why: A reviewer that cannot write cannot quietly change the work it is judging.

carried.text:
Implement the work described by the user in the spec or tickets.

Use /tdd where possible, at pre-agreed seams.

Run typechecking regularly, single test files regularly, and the full test suite once at the end.

Once done, use /code-review to review the work.

Commit your work to the current branch.

assumptions.says: Claude cannot start a skill marked disable-model-invocation.
A Monitor-tool watch ends after 30 minutes.
Superpowers follows the brief's rules over its own, including the text its session-start hook adds.
A marketplace entry's sha installs that exact commit, the project's settings switch off the other copies, and auto-update stays off.
A pre-tool hook refuses edits and commands in a session whose fingerprints did not match, on macOS and Windows.
The undo reinstalls a previous commit from Wheelhouse's marketplace, including after Claude Code's clean-up of old plugin versions.
A background process can start a fresh session and wake a running one, by the route check 27 found.
The Claude Code inside Desktop follows the stable channel and minimum version in the user's settings.
Claude Code's list of installed plugins keeps the shape locateInstalled reads.
